memo: Base: saddamaditya 'Forensics Lab: Apex Synthesis' (public LB 0.451, Apache-2.0, kernels/e3/base_a451.ipynb), unchanged except ours. Finding behind it (our validation e3val4, np-examples 250 molecules, class 3 = truth removed from both engine pools, only in the PubChem tier): the gated PubChem merge puts the truth at MRR 0.80 / top1 0.74, the two-engine fusion drops it to 0.56 / 0.35 (48 top-1 lost, 0 gained), the later overlays to 0.46 / 0.22; c1 (truth in the pool) is 0.94 after the fusion and 0.93 at the end. Parts (ours, kernels/e3/build_pc.py): pcfix = at the end every PubChem-only candidate of the merged list returns to its merged-list rank if a later stage moved it down; pcvote = in the fusion a PubChem-only candidate gets engine 2's vote at its main-list rank; latecut = at the end back to the list of the final metric pass (identity overlay, E005-E007, E2R2 undone). This version: all three parts. Hypothesis: the hidden out-of-pool truths the PubChem tier finds keep their merged rank, LB > 0.451. build.py a451pcl base=a451 pcfix=1 pcvote=1 latecut=1.
message: e3pcl-1: Apex Synthesis 0.451 base (GPU) + our PubChem-only protection (pcfix=1 pcvote=1 latecut=1)
